name: bohonews-site
description: Static-first public website and publishing frontend for Boho News.

scripts.build: npm run content:validate && ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && node scripts/publishing/build-search.mjs
scripts.build:preview: BOHONEWS_PREVIEW=1 node scripts/publishing/validate-preview.mjs source && BOHONEWS_PREVIEW=1 ASTRO_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 astro build && BOHONEWS_PREVIEW=1 node scripts/publishing/build-search.mjs && BOHONEWS_PREVIEW=1 node scripts/publishing/validate-preview.mjs artifact
